name: changeflow-enterprise
description: ChangeFlow Enterprise - Integrated 4M Change Management, CAPEX & Procurement Automation Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
